propositions: Convergence tests that re-derive the external-effect side from helper functions instead of capturing it from the real call site remain green when the send path drifts, defeating the test's purpose.

The truncate_comment_body model in test_outbound_comment_length_convergence.py went stale when the send path moved to AdfCodec.fit_outbound, resulting in 836 unmarked duplicate comments in live Jira while the test passed.

The test-design.md shared standard must document and exemplify the rule that convergence assertions must capture the external-effect side from real call sites, never re-derive it from composed helpers.
Per-skill copies of test-design.md in rebar-debug, rebar-implement, and rebar-brainstorm must be kept byte-identical to the canonical shared copy, enforced by tests/unit/test_skill_shared_sync.py.
A mechanical lint check cannot reliably distinguish re-derived oracles from legitimate characterization tests, as both are syntactically identical and differ only in intent.
The rule is documented as authoring guidance in test-design.md §4 with worked examples from this ticket; no automated lint is added.
